task.title: Connect to the NC State VPN
task.shortdesc: Approved NC State faculty, staff, and students can connect to the university's remote-access VPN using Cisco Secure Client, their Unity credentials, and Duo authentication. Visitors must first obtain confirmation that they are eligible for VPN access.

context.p: This task provides guidance for NC State faculty, students, staff, and visitors. The VPN Acceptable Use Policy identifies approved NC State faculty, staff, and students as eligible users. It does not grant general VPN access to visitors or guests.
Faculty, students, and staff: Complete the connection procedure if you have been granted VPN privileges and have your Unity ID and password.

Visitors: Do not attempt to sign in using another person's credentials. Ask your NC State sponsor or the appropriate university IT support group whether you have been issued an account and VPN authorization. If you have not been authorized, the VPN procedure does not apply to you. For on-campus guest internet access, use the NC State wireless network guidance.
For policy details, see What Is NC State's Virtual Private Network Policy?.

step.cmd: Confirm that you are authorized to use the NC State VPN.

info.p: Approved NC State faculty, students, and staff should confirm that VPN privileges are enabled for their account. Visitors must obtain explicit confirmation of eligibility and account access from their NC State sponsor or university IT support before proceeding.

step.cmd: Install Cisco Secure Client on your device.

info.p: Open the Install the NC State VPN Client article. Choose the instructions for your operating system and complete the installation.
The installation article provides guidance for supported Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, Android, and iOS devices. Follow the current instructions in the article for your device.

step.cmd: Enter vpn.ncsu.edu in the connection field and select Connect.
Select the VPN group specified by NC State for your account or access needs.

info.p: If you do not know which group to select, consult the university's VPN connection instructions or contact the NC State Help Desk. Do not guess at a group selection.

step.cmd: Enter your authorized username and password.

info.p: NC State faculty, students, and staff should use their Unity ID and Unity password. Visitors may proceed only if NC State has issued them an account and explicitly provided VPN authorization and login instructions.
Follow the Duo prompt and the current NC State VPN instructions. The documented options include:

li.p: Enter push in the Second Password field to request a Duo Push notification, then approve the sign-in request you initiated in Duo Mobile.
Enter a passcode from the Duo Mobile app.
Use the security-key method if it is configured for your account and supported by the sign-in prompt.

result.p: After successful authentication, Cisco Secure Client establishes a connection to the NC State VPN for the resources your account is authorized to access.

postreq.p: VPN users are automatically disconnected after a predetermined period of inactivity. Sign in again to reconnect.
Use the VPN in accordance with the NC State VPN Acceptable Use Policy and the NC State Computer Use Regulation. Do not share your credentials or allow unauthorized people to use your VPN connection.
If you cannot install or connect to the VPN, consult the Connect to the NC State VPN article or contact the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-HELP.
Visitors who have not been granted VPN access should contact their NC State sponsor or university IT support. For campus guest Wi-Fi, consult the NC State Wireless Network Access website.
